scope: Root source review and independent real native byte checks, no compilation or product mutation.
findings: Only the failed-Wave callsite is redirected. It invokes the original native MIDI shutdown/plugin-delete/clear before the original unload and returns the unload result. Caller preserves the original Wave error in ESI and reloads it afterward.
Full native close/delete/unload and failure caller bodies match actual66d image. Existing thiscall/cdecl adapters preserve supported native calling conventions without new unsafe code.

Clean preinit owner/module/factory gate declines active/stale/unreadable late injection without dereferencing an already stale backend. Installation is synchronous before imported-IFC startup, status logging deferred to init worker.
Successful native startup and normal shutdown callsites are unchanged. No shader, rendering, audio pitch, clocks, locks or per-frame work added.
Prepared tests cover order, reproduced missing unwind, no-MIDI, result preservation and unknown/changed/late-state gates; actual compiler/runtime evidence still pending.
decision: Isolated tests and Windows compile approved. Shared promotion waits for those checks, then fresh PE and exact failure-case plus loaded-game lifecycle acceptance before Neo promotion.
